predecessors: same independently audited split scenario snapshot and its six independently audited model-fit units; exact seals, release and execution mode pinned separately for qualification and actual
evaluation_scope: fixed original 157 test sessions, both observed timing assumptions, same causal common support within each branch and timing; no refit

policy.immediate_control: all observed high clusters in evaluation, one prospective decision per cluster before scenario confirmation
policy.rules_and_models: rule on all common supported confirmations; three registered models with strict expected gross 30-minute return above cost; unsupported or replay-ambiguous score does not authorize entry
policy.frequency: all original evaluation weeks including zeros; selected, fixed-clock nonoverlapping selected, modeled entries and known outcomes separately; target 15 per week
policy.paired_contribution: same common opportunity; known decline and known entry refusal are zero contribution; unresolved prediction, entry or outcome is missing
policy.reliability: target-first raw probabilities evaluated with five fixed bins, Brier and fold training prevalence; unknown ordering does not become a negative label
policy.candidate: same scenario and model or rule positive net43 with positive lower day-cluster bound and at least ten contributing days under both overlapping timing assumptions; identify selection frequency, concentration and unresolved outcomes separately

management.cohort: same learned entry and nominal lot within each cost; no refit and no redeployment of proceeds
management.sequence: structural close at or below original stop requests full exit; otherwise first available forecast with nonpositive incremental hold value requests one half reduction; second consecutive nonpositive forecast requests full exit; otherwise retain to cap
management.unknown: unavailable or ambiguous holding forecast interrupts the consecutive sequence without authorizing exit; missing requested sale quote leaves residual outcome unresolved and prevents later hypothetical liquidation
management.basis_and_cost: same original entry basis, proportional sale quantity and one-time entry cost; no repeated entry cost per update
management.comparison: same learned entry, matched known paths only for net delta; separate unresolved paths, day-cluster uncertainty, frequency and concentration

verification: separate source and research-integrity review, exact-head CI and normal merge; same original-size qualification with independent reconstruction, persisted artifacts and separate original receipt audit before either actual comparison
